AP_RISING_STRENGTH.title: Rising Strength
AP_RISING_STRENGTH.description: Elites and bosses start each combat with 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] in Act 2 and 2 [gold]Strength[/gold] in Act 3.
AP_ESCALATING_BUFFS.title: Escalating Buffs
AP_ESCALATING_BUFFS.description: Enemies start combat with one random buff in Act 2 and two different ones in Act 3: 1 [gold]Strength[/gold], 4 [gold]Plating[/gold], 2 [gold]Thorns[/gold], 1 [gold]Artifact[/gold], 3 [gold]Regen[/gold], 4 [gold]Curl Up[/gold], 4 [gold]Vigor[/gold] or 1 [gold]Slippery[/gold].
AP_SHRINKING_RESTS.title: Shrinking Rests
AP_SHRINKING_RESTS.description: Resting heals 25% of your Max HP in Act 2 and 20% in Act 3, instead of 30%.
AP_MOUNTING_CURSES.title: Mounting Curses
AP_MOUNTING_CURSES.description: Gain a random curse at the start of Act 2 and of Act 3.
AP_MOUNTING_BANES.title: Mounting Banes
AP_MOUNTING_BANES.description: Gain an [gold]Ascender's Bane[/gold] at the start of Act 2 and of Act 3.
AP_ENEMY_HP_SCALING.title: Enemy HP Scaling
AP_ENEMY_HP_SCALING.description: Enemies have {Percent}% more Max HP in Acts 2 and 3.
AP_ENEMY_DAMAGE_SCALING.title: Enemy Damage Scaling
AP_ENEMY_DAMAGE_SCALING.description: Enemies deal {Percent}% more damage in Acts 2 and 3.
AP_SLOW_START.title: Slow Start
AP_SLOW_START.description: Draw 1 fewer card on the first turn of each combat.
AP_FRAIL_START.title: Frail Start
AP_FRAIL_START.description: Start the run with 10% less Max HP.
AP_DANGEROUS_UNKNOWNS.title: Dangerous Unknowns
AP_DANGEROUS_UNKNOWNS.description: ? rooms lean towards fights. Combat starts at 20% and rises 15% each time a ? room is not a fight. [gold]Elites[/gold] start at 0% and rise 4%. Chests start and rise at 1%. Juzu Bracelet never appears.
AP_EXTRA_ASCENDERS_BANE.title: Extra Ascender's Bane
AP_EXTRA_ASCENDERS_BANE.description: Start the run with an extra [gold]Ascender's Bane[/gold].
AP_EMBER_ENCHANTING.title: Ember Enchanting
AP_EMBER_ENCHANTING.description: Campfires let you [gold]Enchant[/gold] a card with a random enchantment. This uses up the campfire, like upgrading.
AP_COMPOUND_INTEREST.title: Compound Interest
AP_COMPOUND_INTEREST.description: At the start of Act 2 and of Act 3, gain 20% of the [gold]Gold[/gold] you hold, up to 100.
AP_GILDED.title: Gilded
AP_SPRING_CLEANING.title: Spring Cleaning
AP_SPRING_CLEANING.description: After the Act 1 and Act 2 bosses, choose one: remove a card, transform a card, or upgrade 2 random cards.
AP_LOYAL_CUSTOMER.title: Loyal Customer
AP_LOYAL_CUSTOMER.description: Each purchase makes the rest of that shop 15% cheaper, up to 45%.
AP_CAMPFIRE_BREWING.title: Campfire Brewing
AP_CAMPFIRE_BREWING.description: Once per campfire, brew a random potion. You can still rest or upgrade afterwards.
AP_ENDLESS_UPGRADES.title: Endless Upgrades
AP_ENDLESS_UPGRADES.description: Cards can be [gold]Upgraded[/gold] any number of times. Each upgrade adds the card's upgrade bonus again.
